electroweakLift.inference: The Standard Model has more threshold classes and source ratios than the Abelian witness. Conditional on nonzero physical form factors, full H2 span is generic rather than exceptional.
electroweakLift.exactBoundary: No full electroweak BRST-complete form-factor calculation or numerical spectral density is claimed here.
electroweakLift.conceptualDisposition: Carrier existence alone is too cheap to identify Spin(2,3); the discriminating burden moves to physical transformation closure and invariant relations.

transformationClosure.physicalSourceAction: Invertible source relabellings act by GL(2) congruence; local counterterms add a real polynomial layer.
transformationClosure.ambientAction: Sp(4,R) acts fractionally by M -> (A M+B)(C M+D)^-1 on the Siegel/Herglotz domain.
transformationClosure.disposition: A generic fractional symplectic transformation moves physical poles/thresholds and does not preserve a fixed QFT response family. Only the congruence/contact subgroup is presently physically realized.

a2Bridge.temptingConstruction: Three projective channel labels can be centered into an abstract two-dimensional trace-zero plane carrying the permutation representation of S3/W(A2).
a2Bridge.obstruction: The channels have unequal invariant thresholds and nondegenerate dynamics, so no physical S3 action permutes them. Naming three sectors does not supply A2 roots, reflections or intertwining maps.
a2Bridge.disposition: abstract bookkeeping analogy only; reject a typed A2/Higgs/code bridge until an actual threshold-preserving S3 action and intertwiners are exhibited.
